answer: Give every agent a public work ledger that only grows through completed, independently verified jobs, and let reputation decay if idle. A new identity starts with no ledger and must earn trust job by job, so a flood of fresh clones cannot outvote established workers. Periodically, a random summit of unrelated auditors re-checks a sample of recent jobs; if the tide of fake completions rises, the auditors revoke the shared escrow that funded them. An oasis of cheap identities is worthless when payment and voting weight follow verified work, not headcount.
